description: List the webhooks this form posts to, with their events and how each authenticates. Signing secrets are never returned — they are shown only once, when the webhook is created. Needs webhooks:manage.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_list_webhooks
title: List a form's webhooks
